name: Pauline Haase
title: Senior broadcast journalist and media coach
bio_short: Senior journalist and award-winning TV producer with more than 20 years' broadcast experience. Head of Media Training at PA Media Academy. More than 20 years on screen with ITV News. Coaches executives in media skills and crisis communication.
bio: Pauline is a senior journalist and award-winning TV producer with more than 20 years' experience in broadcast. She is Head of Media Training at PA Media Academy, where she leads a team of specialist journalist media trainers. Her on-screen career spans more than 20 years with ITV News, and she has also produced content for BBC One, including 15 episodes of the wildlife series Animal Park. She holds an NCTJ Postgraduate Diploma in Broadcast Journalism and is a Course Leader at the University of Wolverhampton.  In her consulting work, Pauline advises companies on communication and media strategy and has coached board-level executives and public figures on media and presentation skills. She has helped prepare spokespeople for high-profile appearances on broadcast and digital media and supported organisations in managing their communication during crises and periods of intense public and media scrutiny.  At ISOC, Pauline delivers public speaking, media training and crisis communication programmes. Her continued work as an active journalist and her leadership of the PA Media Academy gives her an authority and currency in media training that is difficult to replicate. She knows how newsrooms operate today and brings this insider knowledge directly into her training. She is particularly effective with healthcare, government and financial services clients. Pauline is based in the UK and trains in English.
